feedConsumer.comment: A consumer of a catalogue's protected feeds. Read on every request that carries a feed key

feedConsumer.title: Feed consumer
feedConsumer.summary: An outside consumer of one catalogue's protected feeds
feedConsumer.description: A partner that reads one catalogue's protected feeds (such as its OOAPI feed) with its own keys (REQ-FCC-001). The consumer acts as a Nextcloud account the app manages. A key is stored only as a verifier: the secret is shown once, in the answer that creates it.

name.title: Name
name.description: The name of the consumer, such as the partner's application.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: Who to reach at the consumer about its keys.

catalog.title: Catalogue
catalog.description: The one catalogue whose protected feeds the consumer reads.

account.title: Account
account.description: The Nextcloud account the consumer acts as. Set by the server.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: A disabled consumer's keys are refused.

keys.title: Keys
keys.description: The consumer's keys. Each holds a verifier of its secret, never the secret.

hash.title: Verifier
hash.description: A one-way hash of the key's secret.
